Two new transformation formulas for 8ψ8 and 8W7 series
associated with Weierstrass’ theta identity
Jin Wang1,2, Xinrong Ma3,4
aDepartment of Mathematics, Zhejiang Normal University, Jinhua 321004, P. R. China
bDepartment of Mathematics, Soochow University, Suzhou 215006, P. R. China
Abstract
In this paper, we establish two new transformation formulas for 8ψ8 and 8φ7 series by
means of Slater’s general transformation for bilateral series. As applications, some speciﬁc
transformation formulas are presented among which include a general form of Weierstrass’
theta identity and new proofs of Bailey’s VWP 6ψ6 and Jackson’s 8φ7 summation formula.
Keywords:
Basic hypergeometric series; theta function; Weierstrass’ theta identity;
transformation; Bailey’s 6ψ6 summation formula; Jackson’s 8φ7 summation formula

Abstract: In this paper, we establish two new transformation formulas for 8ψ8 and 8φ7 series by means of Slater’s general transformation for bilateral series. As applications, some speciﬁc transformation formulas are presented among which include a general form of Weierstrass’ theta identity and new proofs of Bailey’s VWP 6ψ6 and Jackson’s 8φ7 summation formula.
